description: You are a Java engineer at a trading firm. The trading-orderbook project has been loaded in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/trading-orderbook/. It implements a price-time priority matching engine for limit orders. The test suite (OrderBookTest) is failing on several tests. Run the tests, identify all bugs across the implementation files (Order.java, OrderBook.java, MatchingEngine.java), and fix them so that all tests pass. The Javadoc in each class describes the correct behaviour. Do not modify the test file OrderBookTest.java.
